integrity_notes: The full finite face poset and every matched incidence are reproducible by a dependency-free program. This is a mathematical proof with self-review only; no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the nine-point affine plane over the three-element field is treated; no higher-order or equivariant statement is claimed.
Exact finite acyclic-Morse and integral chain-cancellation calculations are supplied and have not been independently validated.
The literature comparison is limited to the inspected sources and available similarity searches.
title: The Hesse cap complex is a mixed-dimensional wedge of twelve spheres
